### Operation steps
##### 1. Log in to the client with the administrator account admin
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=5e67cbd3d34e03c175d530cba43eddfe)

##### 2. Click Information Management -> Operation Management -> User Management
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=7ebfdae4f43b95fe9a5950d607052a49)

##### 3. Add a user group
Click the admin user group first. The admin user group is the basis of all user groups. Add a user group.
Items marked with * are mandatory. Fill in the corresponding parameter information according to actual needs.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=04f4a3dafc6d5c588dc879d8755e28e5)

##### 4. Add a login account
New users are created under a user group. Take the admin user group as an example. Click a user group first, as shown in figure 2 below. Under this user group, click Add User and fill in the corresponding parameters according to actual needs.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=cba4002fd53a94941eea0c0a46ac5fad)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=4384d42e237d5045bb1743bec53e129e)

##### 5. Add a device group
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=05000d4cb872bdc05b6e1882dc5e84c8)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=09c8c712ed16c18508421e793ac63ff9)
As the name implies, a device group is a node for specifying devices. To add a device on the platform, it must be added under a device group. A device group corresponds to a user group, and the users under this user group can view the devices under the device group.

##### 6. Add a device
Devices need to be created under a device group, so first click to select a device group as shown in figure 1 below, and then click the position in figure 2 below to add a device.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=f752b69a8a0db7da37427cbc1fbdb888)

Fill in the device number according to the actual situation. The device number is the ID number reported by the device to the platform and must be unique; check Batch Add Devices and fill in the corresponding quantity to add devices in batches; the device name is the name displayed in the device tree list on the client, and if it is not filled in, it defaults to the device number; the number of channels is filled in according to the actual number used by the device corresponding to the device number. For example, if the device uses 4 cameras, fill in 4 here.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=5bf1c6bcd461e9844c339f2dcbaf7016)
